text:
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time – The Ocarina Is the Key – Nintendo Switch 2
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time game launches November 5, 2026, exclusively on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. Pre-orders are available now: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-switch-2/ 

The ocarina is the key to your adventure—its songs can change Hyrule and guide you toward a new destiny. Use it, along with a variety of other items, to journey across time and restore balance to the kingdom in this classic tale, built from the ground up for Nintendo Switch 2. 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s

FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Play FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6004aLsiG
 
Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.  
Begin your journey in FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE in the free demo and experience the story from the opening through the end of Chapter 1. Continue your adventure by carrying over your demo saved data to the full game.
